integrity.claim_scope: all integers n>=3; optimum n-1 monitoring tokens, adjacent slides preserving feasibility
integrity.proof_basis: coordinate-occupancy criterion, exact two-family edge count, constructive path bound, and token-coordinate lower bound

scientific_limitations: The exact movement results concern n-by-n rook graphs for n at least three, not arbitrary rectangular boards.
Shortest-path counts for arbitrary pairs and token-jump distances are not claimed.
Exhaustive all-pairs computational distances cover n=3 and n=4; proofs, not extrapolation, establish statements for all n.
Historical equivalents outside examined literature may exist.
title: The exact token-slide diameter and antipodal pairs of minimum power domination on square rook graphs
